svg.title: Ingestion and private-input boundaries
svg.desc: Two separate data paths. Shared Blob content and permissions belong to source administrators. Native Foundry IQ Blob ingestion manages indexing without Agent App Ingestion. Optional custom Agent App Ingestion can instead populate a compatible Azure AI Search index. Foundry IQ retrieval still requires delegated user authorization and query-time permission checks. Private inline attachments belong to the signed-in conversation owner. An explicit ENABLE_PRIVATE_ATTACHMENTS flag and UI metadata grant are required. The UI/BFF checks ownership and bounded inline inputs, then calls the native conversational backend on Hosted or DTS. That host owns native state. UI-owned Cosmos stores owner mappings and attachment descriptors, never file bytes, transcripts or tokens. Attachments are conversational only, not workflow input, and have no path to shared ingestion or the corporate index. Retrieval and custom ingestion are optional application capabilities, not requirements for every deployment. Blue arrows show data flow; there is no deployment setup path in this diagram.
svg.metadata: Azure Public Service Icons v24, Microsoft. Usage: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/architecture/icons/ . Official icons are embedded intact, uniformly scaled and not recolored. All layout, labels and connectors are editable SVG elements.

g.text: Choose shared source processing, private conversation input, or neither.
Indexing identity writes content; retrieval still requires delegated user access.
No file bytes, transcripts or tokens
Optional: ENABLE_PRIVATE_ATTACHMENTS + UI metadata grant. No workflows.
Private attachments do not enter shared ingestion or the corporate index.
